quarterly_data.signal: Company deck (Citi 2026 Taiwan Tech Conference): King Slide describes itself as the No.1 server rail kits manufacturer. 2025 sales breakdown: Rail Kit 97.87%, Hinge 0.89%, Slide 0.03%, Others 1.21%. Server rail kits are made by subsidiary King Slide Technology at the Kaohsiung Taiwan Science Park (46.08 acres; product lines server rail kit, mechanical total solution and functional kitchen rail kit). The company has 1,500+ employees including 450+ R&D engineers and had 3,782 patents applied and 3,693 approved as of May 6, 2026; it says its cable management arm and thin server rail kits increase the cooling efficiency of servers.
